regions.merged_text: John J Uller - 58 - Wants success in undertaking ... to pay honest debts contracted with best of intentions when every thing went flush .... N.B. Once a millionaire - this man was threatened with the loss of his saintly wife. She had been four days unconscious - her eyes set with mouth open.

regions.merged_text: Mrs. Wm. Quinn - 58 - had breast removed last Oct. She had fallen last May and hurt her breast and in October had it removed. In Feb. & March it was causing great anixiety when on April 9th she had her name inscribed in Sr. Mass A'n. At once it improved.
